adopt_withfb_conditions: nofb fails observable correctness under robust seed/block uncertainty and withfb fixes or materially reduces the same failure
nofb has ratio-estimator instability and withfb repairs the same instability in matched seeds/blocks
nofb transport degradation propagates to estimator quality or high-flow ergodicity risk and withfb repairs that degradation in the same seeds/blocks/edges
withfb is competitive or better in primary information rate per wall-clock hour and does not materially degrade the other primary observable
keep_nofb_conditions: transport warning does not propagate downstream to observable bias, ratio instability, high-flow non-return, or reduced wall-clock-normalized precision
nofb wins or ties withfb in primary 1/SE^2/hour metrics
conclusions survive seed bootstrap, block-size variation, matched-seed common-prefix comparison, and equal-wall-clock comparison

non_circularity_rule.statement: Lower failure count itself is not a criterion.
non_circularity_rule.allowed_use_of_failure: Failure can support a decision only if it predicts or repairs downstream non-failure degradation.
non_circularity_rule.transport_only_rule: Transport-only improvement is not enough for a production switch unless it indicates severe ergodicity risk such as zero-round-trip seeds, high-flow non-return, high-flow trapping, or edge bottleneck trapping.
